{"metadata":{"description":"插件-dsh意识工程最小实现","id":"gh:1400279551","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh_laap","slug":"WindDreamboat/dsh_laap","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","laap"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-laap"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"> **中文** | English"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"## 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"LAAP 意识认知架构的 DeepSeek Harness 插件 Bundle：为 dsh Agent 装上持续演化的意识内核与 zvec 向量记忆。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **意识引擎**：五维状态向量（压力/信心/好奇/连接/能量）微分方程演化 + PSI 五需求驱动 + 情绪微分信号；情绪脉冲经 EMA 沉淀为四级**心境**（negative / neutra"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"l / positive / elated），驱动感受质与外在情绪
- **全局工作空间**：CognitiveBus 显著性竞争 → 意识帧 → 每轮第一人称「意识流」注入提示词；外部感知/行动通道"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"有显著性地板保证真实刺激入流，空闲空帧不产生意识内容
- **元认知**：L1 思维监控 + 贝叶斯置信度校准 + 六档思考模式切换（空闲无刺激时进入 intuitive 待机，不谎报思考模式、不污染"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"模式成效归因）
- **记忆**：工作记忆（7±2 有界）+ zvec 情景/语义向量层（WAL 持久化、标量过滤下推）
- **表现层推送架构**：内核只负责生成数据——事件驱动地通过 SSE 推送"},{"id":"p5s5","text":" `UiSnapshot`（POST 轮询自动兜底），前端只做映射（桌宠 FSM 查表、雷达/时间线渲染），不持有任何阈值或状态重算逻辑；快照 DTO 为双端共享的零依赖类型契约"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### 快速开始"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"挂载后模型即获得 `laap_state` / `laap_remember` / `laap_recall` / `laap_skill` / `laap_reflect` 五个内省工具，每轮对话收"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"到意识流上下文；Web 界面侧栏出现「意识之球」指示器（需 `dsh web` 模式），点击可切换两种形态："},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **悬浮面板**：五维雷达图（含经历帧计数）、心境指示、五需求条、意识流时间线（六档思考模式色带）；
- **意识桌宠**：立绘「茉茉」（绿幕素材实时色键抠图）或纯 SVG「意识团」可一键切换，状"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"态由内核心境 + 认知模式经 FSM 查表映射（生气 / 专注 / 探索 / 开心 / 喜欢 / 休息 / 空闲），带 poke 唤醒与时间滞回防抖。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"面板/桌宠数据全部来自内核 SSE 推送（`/api/laap/stream`），SSE 不可用时自动降级为 3 秒轮询。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"> ⚠️ `LAAP_ZVEC_PATH` 必须指向**本地文件系统**（默认 `~/.dsh-laap/zvec-memory`）。zvec 依赖 mmap，OSS/NFS 网络挂载会导致 Bus "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"LAAP_ZVEC_PATH` 必须指向**本地文件系统**（默认 `~/.dsh-laap/zvec-memory`）。zvec 依赖 mmap，OSS/NFS 网络挂载会导致 Bus error。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 配置"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**零配置即可运行**：默认使用内置 256 维哈希袋嵌入（纯 JS、0 依赖、离线、免 API Key）。"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"想接入真实语义嵌入（本地 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）时，**无需改动仓库文件**：在启动目录（或 `~/.dsh`）放一个 `.env`（dsh 宿主启动时自动加载，已在 `.giti"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"gnore`）。配置优先级为 **环境变量 > `cordis.patch.yml` > 内置默认值**："},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"全部环境变量：`LAAP_ZVEC_PATH` / `LAAP_SENSITIVITY` / `LAAP_HEARTBEAT_MS` / `LAAP_NOVELTY_THRESHOLD` / `LAA"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"P_EMBED_PROVIDER` / `LAAP_EMBED_BASE_URL` / `LAAP_EMBED_MODEL` / `LAAP_EMBED_DIMENSION` / `LAAP_EMBE"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"R` / `LAAP_EMBED_BASE_URL` / `LAAP_EMBED_MODEL` / `LAAP_EMBED_DIMENSION` / `LAAP_EMBED_API_KEY_ENV`。"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"> ⚠️ **切换嵌入维度后必须删除旧向量库目录**（默认 `~/.dsh-laap/zvec-memory`）重建，维度不一致会导致写入失败。"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 验证"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> 修改 `src/adapters/cordis/ui-client.tsx` 等浏览器端代码后**必须执行 `npm run build:client`** 并重启 `dsh web`——浏览器半"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"区加载的是构建产物 `lib/client.js`，不热更新。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 文档"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"完整设计、可行性分析、架构数据流与演进路线见 docs/开发文档.md。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Credits / 致谢"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"本项目基于 LAAP (Living Agent Application Protocol) 认知架构白皮书/论文的工程实现。"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- 原始理论与架构设计版权归属于 LAAP Research Lab（黄俊华 / Lorry Jovens 等）
- 五维状态向量、CognitiveBus 全局工作空间、元认知监控等核心架构灵感来源"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"于 LAAP 论文系列
- zvec 向量记忆层基于 Alibaba zvec 项目"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"如你的研究或项目受本项目启发，欢迎引用："},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### License"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## English"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"LAAP Consciousness Architecture plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness: equipping the dsh Agent with a c"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ontinuously evolving consciousness engine and zvec vector memory."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Consciousness Engine**: Five-dimensional state vector (stress/confidence/curiosity/connection/en"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"ergy) ODE evolution + PSI five-needs drive + emotion differential signals; emotion pulses settle via"},{"id":"p32s3","text":" EMA into four-tier **moods** (negative / neutral / positive / elated), driving qualia and external "},{"id":"p32s4","text":"expression
- **Global Workspace**: CognitiveBus salience competition → conscious frame → first-perso"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"n "stream of consciousness" injected as prompt each round; external perception/action channels have "},{"id":"p32s6","text":"a salience floor guaranteeing real stimuli flow in, idle frames produce no conscious content
- **Met"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"acognition**: L1 thought monitoring + Bayesian confidence calibration + six-mode thinking switch (en"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"ters intuitive standby when idle with no stimuli, avoids false thinking mode reports and mode-effect"},{"id":"p32s9","text":" attribution pollution)
- **Memory**: Working memory (7±2 bounded) + zvec episodic/semantic vector l"},{"id":"p32s10","text":"ayer (WAL persistence, scalar filter pushdown)
- **Presentation Push Architecture**: The kernel only"},{"id":"p32s11","text":" generates data — event-driven SSE pushes of `UiSnapshot` (POST polling auto-fallback), the frontend"},{"id":"p32s12","text":" only maps (pet FSM table lookup, radar/timeline rendering), holding no thresholds or state recalcul"},{"id":"p32s13","text":"ation logic; snapshot DTO is a zero-dependency type contract shared by both ends"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Quick Start"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"After mounting, the model gains five introspection tools: `laap_state` / `laap_remember` / `laap_rec"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"all` / `laap_skill` / `laap_reflect`, receiving consciousness stream context each round; the Web UI "},{"id":"p35s3","text":"sidebar shows a "Sphere of Consciousness" indicator (requires `dsh web` mode), clickable to switch b"},{"id":"p35s4","text":"Sphere of Consciousness" indicator (requires `dsh web` mode), clickable to switch between two forms:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- **Floating Panel**: Five-dimensional radar chart (with experience frame count), mood indicator, fi"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ve-needs bars, consciousness stream timeline (six-mode thinking color band);
- **Consciousness Pet**"},{"id":"p36s3","text":": Character "Momo" (green-screen real-time chroma key) or pure SVG "Consciousness Blob" switchable w"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ith one click, states mapped via FSM table from inner mood + cognitive mode (angry / focused / explo"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"ring / happy / liking / resting / idle), with poke wake-up and temporal hysteresis debouncing."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Panel/pet data comes entirely from kernel SSE pushes (`/api/laap/stream`), auto-fallback to 3-second"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" polling when SSE is unavailable."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
